messages:
incident-bot: Pager: sev2 — multiple runtime containers in gpu-pool-3 entering CrashLoopBackOff. Auto-notify to #incidents and oncall.
sara: seeing a big restart wave on runtime-v2. Started ~15:03 UTC. Affected pods have signal 11 / segfaults in runtime-engine.so. Rediscovering impacted customers now.
devon: confirmed. grabbing `kubectl logs` from a few. first snippet below.

sara: ```
--- logs from runtime-v2-abcde (container: runtime) ---
[2026-03-15T15:03:11Z] INFO starting request
[2026-03-15T15:03:12Z] ERROR runtime: unexpected signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
#0  0x7f8a12b3 in fused_attention_forward + 0x2a3f (runtime-engine.so)
#1  0x7f8a4d10 in compute_attention
#2  0x7f8b0020 in vllm_infer
/var/log/pods/...: terminating with exit code 139
--- end ---
```

lee: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` snapshot:
```
NAME                 READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE    NODE
runtime-v2-abcde     0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   9          11m   gpu-gtx-03
runtime-v2-fghij     0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   6          9m    gpu-gtx-04
runtime-v2-klmno     1/1     Running            0          2m    gpu-gtx-05
```

nina: dmesg from gpu-gtx-03 shows a recent GPU driver oops around the same time. also saw `invalid read` reported from the fused kernel. copying below.

nina: ```
[Mar15 15:03:12] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 69, GPU fault detected: 0x10c0
[Mar15 15:03:12] segfault at 0 ip 00007f8a12b3 sp 00007ffc6a12 error 4 in runtime-engine.so
```

matt: customer-ops: any reports from customers? what endpoints impacted?
customer-ops: Generation endpoints in `prod-us-east-1` using runtime-v2 on gpu-pool-3 are returning 503/502 intermittently. We have 3 paying customers showing elevated error rates: AcmeHealth, Queryly, and ChatFlow. Alerting them now, blackbox checks failing for ~10m.

devon: immediate mitigation options:
- isolate offending nodes (cordon gpu-gtx-03, gpu-gtx-04)
- disable fused kernel path via env var RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 and restart pods (non-invasive)
- rollback runtime image to last known-good tag (slower, safer)

sara: trying non-invasive first. setting env and rolling pods in inference namespace. command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-v2 -n inference RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-v2 -n inference
kubectl get pods -n inference -w
```

lee: doing it now. patches applied at 15:12 UTC.

incident-bot: Note: Scheduled rollout started by sara at 15:12 UTC. Monitor for at least 3 minutes before declaring stabilization.

lee: after restart, pods on gpu-gtx-03 are coming up with the env var, crashloops dropped. restart counts have stopped incrementing for the restarted replicas.

sara: verified traffic — error rate for generation endpoints dropped from 8% -> 0.8% on affected namespaces. customer-ops: please confirm with the three customers.

customer-ops: AcmeHealth and Queryly acknowledge degraded but returning to normal. ChatFlow still seeing a lower error spike but much improved. SLA risk reduced. continuing to monitor and will keep customers updated.

devon: good. assign follow-ups:
- hotfix to remove fused-kernel regression (engineering) => matt + nina
- add guardrail to disable fused path automatically on segfault patterns (runtime) => devon
- post-incident e2e test covering fused kernel memory patterns (qa) => sara
- add alert: if >5 pods CrashLoopBackOff in a pool within 10m, auto-cordon node & alert oncall (sre) => lee

matt: digging into the commit that introduced fused attention refactor. likely a regression when sequence length > 8192 on certain CUDA drivers. grabbing dev debug build to reproduce.

nina: kernel/GPU driver logs and coredumps collected to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1744444444/. saving pod manifests and kubelet logs from gpu-gtx-03.

devon: handing off to matt for the remainder of shift. summary: mitigation applied (RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1), nodes cordoned where necessary, customer impact reduced to minor. root-cause investigation in progress. on-call handover notes in #oncall-handoffs.

sara: oncall handoff: matt takes lead until 23:30 UTC. if crashloops resume or error rate >3% for any prod generation route, escalate to SEV1.

matt: acknowledged. I'll continue postmortem and coordinate hotfix. leaving this thread open for updates.

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 15:27 UTC (recovery threshold met). Incident severity downgraded to sev3 for follow-ups.

sara: quick retrospective items (add to postmortem):
- regression test for fused kernel edge-cases
- better canary for runtime kernels (small fraction of traffic with stress patterns)
- automatic safe-fallback env toggle when segfault pattern detected
- document rollback playbook for runtime image and env toggles

matt: will attach PR references and timeline to the incident doc. assigning owners now.

lee: nodes gpu-gtx-03, gpu-gtx-04 remain cordoned until patched and validated. kubeadm/drivers scheduled for maintenance window 18:00 UTC.

customer-ops: outbound messages sent to impacted customers with ETA and mitigation summary.

sara: closing loop here. reopen thread if anything regresses.
